title: learnc: fit the constants in existing C code to data (9.1% smaller JPEGs, +4.9 F1 on WebRTC VAD) [P]
summary: learnc tunes named constants in unmodified C code against a score function you write in C, and writes the same file back with new values. Results, both on held-out data: JPEG, stb_image_write.h (128 quantization-table entries, tuned on 12 Kodak images, tested on the other 12): 9.
reason: Not a model release, research paper, industry event, or policy action. Reddit post about a C constant-tuning tool; link is reddit.com, not a repository or official announcement, so tools-oss rule 5-1 unmet.
